notes.title: Update 6/5/2024
notes.content:
Update notes:

Balanced some sound volume issues.
Fixed some bugs.
Removed the part where the loading bar gets stuck.
Added a few new sound effects.
Added a few new things Voice Inside Your Head says to you during the game.

Enjoy!

P.S. - Wishlist Call Hating 2000, the sequel to Call Hating, on Steam today! Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759560/Call_Hating_2000/?beta=0]Call Hating 2000 Steam Page[/url]

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
Fixed bugs:

- Player can no longer accidentally pause the game on the tombstone scene.
- Color issues and text overlap fixed on MP3 player.
- "Hang up" button removed from text popup due to issues.

notes.title: Small Update 8-3-2023
notes.content:
Fixed a pernicious bug on the laptop that sometimes prevented programs from being opened from the "Begin" menu.

Minor visual polishes, including resizing windows on the laptop, drawer animations, and inconsistent camera movement.

notes.title: Small Update 8-1-2023
notes.content: - Fixed some late-game bugs and replaced some outdated textures.

notes.title: 7-28-23 Small fix
notes.content:
- fixed a game-breaking bug in the late game where a closed window on the laptop would not reopen.
- the "click" label on the cursor now only shows on left-click

notes.title: 7-25-2023 Tiny Update
notes.content:
- Adjusted car audio attenuation distance.
- Changed wood grain pattern on desk.

.. Oh, and try messing with the voice volume slider. :)

notes.title: 7-24-23 Update - Bug fixes, car key

Fixed various bugs.

Added a car key to the kitchen. Maybe there's a way to drive off into the sunset and forget about that presentation?

notes.title: Pre-release update notes
notes.content:
Update from Jon, the developer:

Call Hating is releasing in 4 short days, and I've been hard at work making Call Hating a unique and engaging experience. Under the hood, I've added a system of milestones that help keep the player "on track" with extra narration. This was an ambitious addition for the last week, but it was much needed to really bring the narrator (Voice Inside Your Head, or VInYH "Vinnie") to life and make it feel like he's really there with you. I hope you enjoy the many extra narration prompts. 

Other than that, I am working up to the release date with beta testers (shoutout to Dane especially, who has been of immense help) to smooth out all the wrinkles in terms of bugs and shaping the player experience.

I am very excited to bring my passion project of over 2 years to the world, and I hope you all enjoy it. Thank you to everyone who wishlisted Call Hating and tried the demo over Steam NextFest.

Peace, love, and Call Hating.
